curriculum.note: The Cambridge Lower Secondary English framework is not in this class folder on Google Drive, which holds only scanned coursebooks and workbooks with no text layer. The three strands below, and the sub-strands under Reading and Writing, are the published Cambridge 1111 structure: each of Reading and Writing opens with a broad-skills sub-strand, and the rest map onto the sub-strands Checkpoint reports against. The wording under each is a faithful statement of what Cambridge asks for at this stage, not a quotation from the framework, and the individual objective numbers are missing. Speaking and listening is taught here but Cambridge does not test it at Checkpoint. Add the Stage 8 framework and the exact codes can be attached lesson by lesson.

objectives.title: Develop broad reading skills: read widely and independently, and respond personally to a text
Demonstrate understanding of explicit meaning: retrieve, summarise and paraphrase what a text states
Demonstrate understanding of implicit meaning: infer and deduce, supporting each reading with evidence
Analyse language and structure: explain a writer's choices of word, sentence and text structure and their effect
Evaluate viewpoint, purpose and effect: recognise conventions, bias and viewpoint, and compare texts
Develop broad writing skills: spell accurately, use a range of vocabulary, and present work legibly
Content and audience: select content, register and form to suit purpose, audience and genre
Text structure: shape a whole text with paragraphs, cohesion and a controlled opening and ending
Sentence structure and punctuation: use varied sentence structures and accurate punctuation for effect
Spelling and vocabulary: apply spelling patterns, word roots and precise vocabulary
Making a contribution: speak with clarity and adapt talk to purpose, audience and context
Responding and reflecting: listen closely, question, build on others' ideas and reflect on the discussion

plan.intro: Show a paragraph of your own writing and improve it in front of the class.
